name: ts_f3_retention
title: What happens to a skill after its teach ends
caption: Retention as a loss curve: after a skill's own segment ends, its held-out loss is nearly flat across the remaining tens of thousands of updates on other skills. The English control panel (never trained) stays where it started.
alt: Line chart on a log scale with one curve per skill showing held-out loss across the entire 63,282-update stream; each curve is close to flat after the skill's own segment; an English control line is flat near 3 nats.
